primary_metric.name: paper_macro_changed_file_recall
primary_metric.per_unit: number of retrieved unique changed file paths divided by all unique changed file paths for the paper
primary_metric.aggregation: unweighted macro mean over confirmatory paper-repository components

primary_estimator: paired mean difference between frontier_obligations and the frozen strongest non-oracle baseline

hypothesis_test.method: two-sided paired randomization test on paper-level recall differences

secondary_metrics: mean reciprocal rank of the first changed file
all changed files retrieved per paper
changed-file recall at 8192 and 32768 selected-code tokens

secondary_tests.subgroups: descriptive intervals with Holm correction; no subgroup success claims

missingness: No gold-based exclusions. Failed retrieval or invalid model output receives an empty ranking. Infrastructure failures trigger reserve substitution only before split sealing and are fully reported.

downstream_gate.comparison: same discrepancy detector and call budget over contexts selected by frontier_obligations and the frozen strongest baseline
downstream_gate.required_for_reviewer_claim: improved discrepancy recall without a lower precision-recall trade-off on the tested synthetic corpus
